dedupe_keys.name: building template ontology and urban building ontology for ontology driven urban building energy modelling data and code

description: This deposit shares two ontologies for urban building energy modelling, with example queries and simulation code: a Building Template Ontology that manages building energy simulation templates, and an Urban Building Ontology that organises building physics information such as geometry, construction and materials. It was published on figshare in April 2024 by Rui Ma to accompany the paper in Sustainable Cities and Society (2024) that proposes using semantic web technology to integrate cross-domain data and generate simulation-ready inputs for city-scale building energy models. The package contains the two ontologies in RDF, GeoSPARQL queries that link them to geographic data, and the building energy simulation code; an earlier deposit holds the same approach. Coverage: a generic method; the case area used is described in the paper. Access: open download from figshare. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: a research prototype tied to one paper, with no maintained release. Simulation uses are structuring building stock data for urban energy models and linking city information to simulation templates in digital twins. Related records: archetypal and the Kigali building typology.
